statement: The deontic gauge group D4 was DISCOVERED IN DATA ('found by testing every transformation against thousands of moral scenarios').
scope: As asserted in the methodology chapter (§17.0.2) and the objective/governed table (§17.0.3).

evidence.note: CONTRADICTED by the book's own registry, which grades D4 a Conditional Theorem from Axioms A1-A5, and by Appendix E which states the D4 empirical test HAS NOT BEEN RUN (line 41711).
